caption: In the unit test the driver calls calculateGST(1000, 18) and gets ₹180. In integration it calls Billing, which gets ₹1,180 from the Invoice stub and calls calculateGST(1180, 18) for ₹212.40, giving a total of ₹1,392.40.

spec.aria: Sequence diagram: a test driver calls calculateGST with amount 1000 and rate 18 and receives 180; then calls Billing, which receives 1180 from an Invoice stub, calls calculateGST with 1180 and 18 to get 212.40, and returns a total of 1392.40.
